scenes.setting: Interrogation and bail: eighteen minutes passed in the house where Klein felt barely three, a doorbell he never heard, and no trace of Stanton or his attacker leaving a sealed room; fifty pounds later, Jurgen's advice on the pavement — never answer a policeman without looking at your lawyer first
scenes.text_anchor: “you were in the house for about eighteen minutes, not two or three minutes!

scenes.setting: In the carriage, hungry past his usual dinner hour — until the stone-faced lawyer mentions he's had his grandmother cook for three
scenes.text_anchor: “I’ve asked my grandmother to prepare dinner for three.”

scenes.setting: Home after dinner: a Seer's intuition that a stranger has been inside, a letter written in coagulated blood — 'All of you will die!' — and another upstairs: 'You're next.' Across the street the lamplight shadows twist into a tailcoated figure that aims a finger-gun at his window and blows the smoke away
